preconditions.expression: isinstance(matrix, list) and all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The input matrix must be a list of lists.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == len(matrix[0]) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: All rows in the matrix must have the same length.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in [0, 1] for row in matrix for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the matrix must be either 0 (landmine) or 1 (safe).
The matrix must have at least one row and one column.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or isinstance(return_value, int) and return_value > 0
postconditions.description: The function must return an integer greater than 0 if a path exists, otherwise -1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or any(matrix[row][0] == 1 for row in range(len(matrix)))
postconditions.description: If a path exists, it must start from a safe cell in the first column.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or any(matrix[row][-1] == 1 for row in range(len(matrix)))
postconditions.description: If a path exists, it must end in a safe cell in the last column.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or all(matrix[row][col] == 1 for row in range(len(matrix)) for col in range(len(matrix[0])) if matrix[row][col] == 0 or any(matrix[row + dr][col + dc] == 0 for dr, dc in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)] if 0 <= row + dr < len(matrix) and 0 <= col + dc < len(matrix[0])))
postconditions.description: If a path exists, it must avoid landmines and their adjacent cells.
